topography.project_purpose: Liquid Restaking. Structurally: 53 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 6 ERC4626 vaults, 13 ERC20 tokens; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 21 common project-authored base contract(s) (accessmanaged, accessmanagedupgradeable, contextupgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
